pages.text: “Sunlight cascades, golden petals bloom, granting the power of light-footed leaps.”$(br2)Marigold Tea is a bright and energizing beverage made from dried marigold petals and sugar. The golden-colored tea has a refreshing taste. Drinking it grants a Jump Boost effect, making travelers’ steps lighter and more agile.

$(br2)$(br)To prepare Marigold Tea, $(br)boil dried marigold petals with sugar.$(br)It is best consumed when traversing rugged terrain or situations requiring extra jumping ability, allowing travelers to clear obstacles effortlessly.

Upon drinking Marigold Tea, travelers gain a Jump Boost effect, allowing them to jump higher and farther.$(br)This tea is great for improving mobility in complex landscapes.$(br)If JEI is installed, press R while hovering over the icon to view the recipe.
